description: This file contains a PHP class 'Extension' within the OpenCart admin marketplace controllers, defining the logic for handling marketplace extensions in the admin panel, including loading languages, managing breadcrumbs, permissions, and listing extensions.

classes.name: Extension
classes.description: Controller class for managing marketplace extensions in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the extensions page, loading languages, setting page title, preparing breadcrumbs, listing extension categories, checking permissions, loading header/footer/column controllers, and rendering the view.
